title: PIXL 8000 Double Apple Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Double Apple blends the crisp tang of Green Apple with the juicier sweetness of Red Apple for a layered fruit vape that’s both fresh and flavourful. A well-rounded choice for all-day vaping. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes paired with a 10ml refill reservoir for up to 8000 puffs using the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. The mesh coil inside the pod ensures consistent vapour and flavour delivery from start to finish. This pod is designed for MTL vaping, with simple draw-activation and Boost Mode for denser clouds. Double Apple is a staple in the PIXL range and ideal for fans of crisp, fruity blends.
